text:
liz-sales: FinCorp demo just failed — streaming responses truncated in their Android webview. Execs saw partial JSON. Can we triage?

fin-customer: Yes. Happens ~1/8 streams. Console: 'Unexpected end of JSON input'. Using hosted us-east, JS SDK v1.1.

mike-se: Are they behind any corp proxy or CDN?

fin-customer: They route through CloudFront then an internal proxy. Desktop Chrome ok, only in-app webview.

rana-eng: Likely split SSE frames + webview network behavior. Short-term: add tolerant reassembly in SDK and a debug flag to capture raw frames. Also ask infra to check keepalive.

tom-support: I'll request edge keepalive be increased for the customer's POC window and prepare fallback non-streaming endpoint for the demo.

mike-se: I'll assemble a tiny patched SDK (buffer on parse error, wait 500ms for remainder) and a repro script that simulates mid-byte splits.

fin-customer: Please hurry — demo in 8 hours.

liz-sales: Thanks team. Mike/rana/tom — aim for artifact + runbook in 3 hours. I'll update the customer.
